1: Logon ka Qayamat ke din apne aamaal ka hisaab dena qareeb aa gaya hai, magar woh apni gaflat mein Aakhirat se munh moad rahe hain, duniya mein masroof hone ki wajah se.
2: Aur un ke paas Quran ka koi naya utra hua hissa nahin aata magar yeh ke woh use is tarah sunte hain ke us se koi faida nahin uthate, balke khel ke taur par sunte hain, us ke mazmoon ki koi parwah kiye bagair.
3: Woh use is haal mein sunte hain ke un ke dil us se gaafil hote hain. Aur jo log kufr se zulm karte hain unhon ne apni chhupi baat chhupayi jab unhon ne kaha: 'Yeh shaks jo rasool hone ka daawa karta hai, tum hi jaisa ek aadmi hi to hai, tum se koi farq nahin rakhta. Jo kuch woh laaya hai woh jaadu hai. Phir kya tum us ke peeche chaloge jab ke tum jaante ho ke woh tum hi jaisa ek aadmi hai aur jo kuch woh laaya hai woh jaadu hai?'
4: Rasool ﷺ ne kaha: 'Mera Rubb us baat ko jaanta hai jo tum ne chhipayi, kyunke Woh har us baat ko jaanta hai jo aasmaano aur zameen mein koi kehta hai. Aur Woh apne bandon ki baatein sunne wala aur un ke aamaal ko jaanne wala hai, jin ka woh unhein badla dega.'
5: Magar woh us baare mein be-yaqeen the jo Muhammad ﷺ laaye. Kabhi woh kehte: 'Yeh uljhe hue khwaab hain jin ka koi matlab nahin.' Aur kabhi kehte: 'Nahin, balke us ne ise bina kisi buniyaad ke ghad liya.' Aur kabhi kehte: 'Yeh jaadugar hai. Agar woh apne daawe mein sachcha hai to hamare paas pichle rasoolon jaisa koi mojiza laaye, jaise woh mojize laaye jaise Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki laathi aur Saleh (alaihis salaam) ki ountni.'
6: In mutalba karne walon se pehle koi aisi basti nahin jis ne nishaniyan utarne ka mutalba kiya ho aur phir use us ke mutalbe ke mutabiq de diya gaya ho aur phir woh iman laayi ho. Balke unhon ne unhein jhutlaya to Maine unhein halak kar diya. Phir kya yeh log iman laayenge?
7: Aur aey Rasool, Maine aap se pehle insaano mein se mardon ke siwa kisi ko nahin bheja jin ki taraf Main wahi karta tha. Maine unhein farishte bana kar nahin bheja, lihaza apne se pehle ahl-e-kitab se poochh lo agar tum yeh nahin jaante.
8: Aur Maine jin rasoolon ko bheja unhein aise jism nahin banaya jo khana na khate hon. Balke woh usi tarah khate the jaise doosre khate hain, aur woh duniya mein bina maut ke hamesha rehne wale nahin the.
9: Phir Maine woh wada poora kiya jo Maine apne rasoolon se kiya tha, chunanche Maine unhein aur mominon mein se jinhein Maine chaaha, halakat se bacha liya. Aur Maine un logon ko halak kar diya jo Allah ka inkaar karke aur nafarmani karke hadein phaand gaye.
10: Aur Maine tum par woh Quran utara jis mein tumhari izzat aur tumhara fakhr hai, agar tum us par iman laao aur us ke mazmoon par amal karo. Phir kya tum yeh nahin samajhte, taake tum us par iman laane aur us par amal karne mein jaldi karo?
11: Aur kitni hi bastiyan hain jinhein Maine kufr se zulm karne ki wajah se halak kar diya, aur un ke baad Maine doosre log paida kiye.
12: Phir jab halak hone walon ne Mera halak karne wala azaab dekha, to woh apni bastiyon se halakat se bhaagne ke liye doorne lage.
13: Unhein mazaaq ke taur par pukara ja raha tha: 'Bhaago nahin, balke apne un aish ki taraf laut aao jin mein tum the aur apne gharon ki taraf, taake tum se tumhare duniyavi saaman ke baare mein kuch poocha ja sake.'
14: In zaalimon ne, apne gunahon ka iqrar karte hue, kaha: 'Haaye hamari barbaadi aur hamari halakat! Hum Allah ka inkaar karke zaalim the.'
15: Chunanche woh apne gunahon ka iqrar karte aur apni halakat ki dua karte rahe yahan tak ke Maine unhein kaati hui kheti ki tarah kar diya: murda, bina kisi harkat ke.
16: Aur Maine aasmaano aur zameen ko aur jo kuch un ke darmiyan hai khel ke taur par ya be-kaar nahin banaya, balke Maine unhein apni qudrat dikhane ke liye banaya.
17: Agar Main koi biwi ya koi aulaad banana chahta to Main apni taraf se aisa kar leta. Magar Maine aisa nahin kiya kyunke Main is se paak hoon.
18: Balke Main us haqq ko jo Main apne rasoolon par utarta hoon kafiron ke baatil par de maarta hoon, aur woh use mita deta hai, phir un ka baatil chala jata hai aur khatam ho jata hai. Aur aey woh logo jo kehte ho ke Allah ne koi biwi ya koi beta bana liya, tumhare liye halakat hai, kyunke tum Use un sifaton se bayan karte ho jo Us ke laayak nahin.
19: Aur aasmaano ki baadshahat aur zameen ki baadshahat sirf Usi ki hai. Aur jo farishte Us ke paas hain woh na Us ki ibadat ko haqeer samajhte hain aur na us se thakte hain.
20: Woh lagatar Us ki paaki bayan karte rehte hain aur is se nahin thakte.
21: Magar mushrikon ne Allah ke siwa aise maabood bana liye jo murdon ko zinda nahin kar sakte, phir woh aisi cheez ki ibadat kaise karte hain jo yeh kar hi nahin sakti?
22: Agar aasmaano aur zameen mein bahut se maabood hote to dono barbaad ho jate, kyunke maabood baadshahat mein jhagadte. Magar haqeeqat aisi nahin. Lihaza Allah, jo Arsh ka Rubb hai, us jhoot se paak hai jis se mushrik Use bayan karte hain, yani yeh ke Us ke sharik hain.
23: Aur Allah apni baadshahat aur apne faisle mein yakta hai. Koi Us se nahin poochh sakta ke Us ne kya faisla kiya aur kya hukm diya, jab ke Woh apne bandon se un ke aamaal ke baare mein poochega aur unhein usi ke mutabiq badla dega.
24: Magar unhon ne Allah ke siwa doosre maabood bana liye. Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: 'Un ke ibadat ke laayak hone ki apni daleel laao. Yeh kitab jo mujh par utari gayi aur woh kitabein jo rasoolon par utari gayin, un mein tumhare liye koi daleel nahin.' Balke mushrikon mein se aksar sirf na-waaqfiyat aur andhi taqleed ka sahara lete hain, is liye woh haqq maanne se munh mod lete hain.
25: Aur aey Rasool, Maine aap se pehle koi rasool nahin bheja magar yeh ke Maine us ki taraf wahi ki ke Mere siwa koi sachcha maabood nahin, lihaza sirf Meri ibadat karo aur Mere saath kisi ko sharik na thehrao.
26: Aur mushrikon ne kaha: 'Allah ne farishton ko betiyan bana liya.' Allah us jhoot se paak aur buland hai jo woh kehte hain. Balke farishte to Allah ke bande hain, jinhein Us ne izzat di aur apne qareeb kiya.
27: Woh apne Rubb se pehle koi baat nahin karte, lihaza woh us waqt tak nahin bolte jab tak Woh unhein hukm na de, aur woh Us ke hukm ke mutabiq amal karte hain aur Us ke kisi hukm ki mukhalifat nahin karte.
28: Woh un ke pehle aur baad ke aamaal ko jaanta hai. Woh sirf Us ki ijazat se aur us ke liye sifarish ki darkhwast karte hain jis ki sifarish Woh pasand kare. Aur woh Us ke khauf se darte rehte hain, is liye woh Us ke kisi hukm ya kisi mumaniat ki mukhalifat nahin karte.
29: Aur agar farishton mein se koi kahe: 'Main Allah ke siwa ek maabood hoon,' to Main use us ki baat par Jahannam ka azaab doonga, jis mein woh hamesha rahega. Aur isi tarah ke azaab se Main un logon ko saza deta hoon jo kufr aur shirk se zulm karte hain.
30: Kya jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya woh nahin jaante ke aasman aur zameen aapas mein mile hue the aur un ke darmiyan koi darz nahin thi ke us se baarish utarti, phir Maine unhein alag kar diya? Aur Maine har jaanwar aur har poda us paani se banaya jo aasman se utarta hai. Kya woh is par gaur nahin karte aur sirf Allah par iman nahin laate?
31: Aur Maine zameen par mazboot pahaad banaye taake woh un logon ko jo us ki satah par hain hila na de. Aur Maine us mein kushaada raaste aur rehguzar banayin, taake woh apne safar mein apni manzilon ki taraf raasta paayein.
32: Aur Maine aasman ko ek aisi chhat banaya jo girne se mehfooz hai aur jis ka koi sutoon nahin, aur jo baatein chori hone se bhi mehfooz hai. Magar mushrik munh mod lete hain aur aasman ki nishaniyon par gaur nahin karte, jaise sooraj aur chaand.
33: Aur Allah hi yakta hai jis ne raat ko aaram ke liye banaya, din ko rozi kamane ke liye banaya, sooraj ko din ki nishani banaya aur chaand ko raat ki nishani. Aur sooraj aur chaand dono apne muqarrar daayron mein chalte hain, na hatte hain aur na us se bahar jate hain.
34: Aey Rasool, Maine aap se pehle kisi insaan ko is zindagi mein hamesha rehne nahin diya. Phir agar is zindagi mein aap ki umar poori ho jaye aur aap wafat paa jayein, to kya woh aap ke baad hamesha jiyenge? Hargiz nahin.
35: Har momin aur har kafir jaan ko duniya mein maut ka maza chakhna hai. Aur aey logo, Main tumhein duniya ki zindagi mein faraiz, naimaton aur mushkilon se aazmata hoon, phir tumhari maut ke baad tum sirf Meri taraf lautaye jaoge, kisi aur ki taraf nahin, phir Main tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla doonga.
36: Aey Rasool, jab yeh mushrik aap ko dekhte hain to sirf aap ka mazaaq udate hain, apne pairokaaron ki nazar mein aap ko haqeer banane ki koshish karte hue, aur kehte hain: 'Kya yahi woh shaks hai jo tumhare poojne wale maaboodon ko bura kehta hai?' Jab ke woh khud us Quran ka inkaar karte hain jo Allah ne un par utara aur un naimaton ka bhi jo Us ne unhein dein, aur is ke saath aap ka mazaaq bhi udate hain. Lihaza woh khud zillat ke zyada qareeb hain, kyunke unhon ne har burai jama kar rakhi hai.
37: Insaan ki fitrat mein jaldbaazi rakhi gayi hai, is liye woh chahta hai ke cheezein apne muqarrar waqt se pehle ho jayein. Aur mushrikon ka azaab maangna isi fitrat ka natija hai. Aey Mera azaab jald maangne walo, Main tumhein theek wahi dikhaoonga jise tum jald maangte ho, lihaza use maangne ki koi zaroorat nahin.
38: Aur jo kafir dobara zinda hone ko jhutlate hain woh apni jaldbaazi mein kehte hain: 'Aey musalmano, agar tum apne daawe mein sachche ho, to yeh dobara zinda hona jis ka tum hum se wada karte ho kab hoga?'
39: Agar dobara zinda hone ko jhutlane wale yeh kafir us waqt ko jaante jab woh Jahannam ki aag ko apne chehron aur apni peethon se hata na sakenge, to woh use maangne mein itni jaldi na karte. Aur agar woh jaan lete ke koi nahin hoga jo unhein azaab se nijaat dilaye, aur agar unhein is ki haqeeqat ka yaqeen hota, to woh bhi jaldi na karte.
40: Yeh aag jis se unhein azaab diya jayega un par achanak aa jayegi, bina is ke ke unhein is ki tawaqqo ho. Woh use na rok sakenge aur na unhein mohlat di jayegi ke woh tauba karein aur phir un par reham kiya jaye.
41: Aey Rasool, agar aap ki qaum aap ka mazaaq udati hai to aap akele nahin hain, kyunke aap se pehle bhi bahut se rasoolon ka mazaaq udaya gaya. Phir jab un ke rasoolon ne unhein us azaab se daraya jis ka kafir mazaaq udate the, to usi azaab ne unhein isi duniya mein gher liya.
42: Aey Rasool, un logon se keh dijiye jo azaab jald maang rahe hain: 'Raat aur din tumhein us azaab aur us halakat se kaun bachayega jise Rehman tum par bhejna chahe?' Balke woh apne Rubb ki nasihat aur Us ki dalilon se munh mod rahe hain; woh nadani aur na-waaqfiyat mein un par koi gaur nahin karte.
43: Kya un ke aise maabood hain jo unhein Mere azaab se bachayenge? Woh to khud apni bhi madad nahin kar sakte: na koi nuqsan hata sakte hain aur na koi faida laa sakte hain! Aur jo apni hi madad na kar sake woh doosron ki madad kaise karega? Aur na unhein Mere azaab se bachaya jayega.
44: Balke Maine in kafiron ko aur in ke bap-dada ko apni woh tamam naimatein di jo Maine un par kein, taake waqt guzarne ke saath woh un se gaafil ho jayein aur apne kufr par jame rahein, aur dheere dheere apne aap ko halakat mein daal lein. Phir kya yeh log, jo Meri naimaton ke dhoke mein hain aur Mera azaab jald maangte hain, yeh nahin samajhte ke Main zameen ko har taraf se ghata raha hoon, logon par apne asar aur un par apni qudrat se? Kya woh is se sabaq nahin lete, kahin un ke saath bhi aisa hi na ho? Yeh log ghalib nahin aayenge; woh shikast khayenge.
45: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: 'Aey logo, main tumhein sirf us wahi ke zariye Allah ke azaab se daraata hoon jo mera Rubb mujh par utarta hai.' Aur jo log haqq ke liye behre hain, jab unhein Allah ke azaab se daraya jata hai to woh use maanne wale kaan se nahin sunte.
46: Aey Rasool, agar in logon ko, jo azaab jald maang rahe hain, aap ke Rubb ke azaab ka thoda sa hissa bhi aa pakde, to woh zaroor kahenge: 'Haaye hamari barbaadi aur hamara ghaata! Hum Allah ke saath sharik thehrane aur us baat ko jhutlane mein galat the jo Muhammad ﷺ hamare paas laaye!'
47: Aur Main Qayamat ke din uthaye jaane walon ke aamaal tolne ke liye insaaf wali tarazu rakhoonga. Us din kisi jaan par zulm nahin hoga: na us ki nekiyan ghatai jayengi aur na us ki buraiyan barhayi jayengi. Aur agar tola jaane wala amal rai ke daane ke barabar bhi ho to Main use bhi shaamil karoonga. Aur apne bandon ke aamaal ka hisaab lene ke liye Main khud kaafi hoon.
48: Aur Maine Moosa aur Haroon (alaihimas salaam) ko Taurat di, jo halal aur haraam mein farq karti thi; jo un logon ke liye hidayat thi jo us par iman laaye, aur un ke liye nasihat jo apne Rubb se darte the.
49: Woh log jo apne Rubb ke azaab se darte hain jis par woh iman rakhte hain, chahe unhon ne Use dekha nahin, aur jo Qayamat se darte hain.
50: Aur yeh Quran, jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya, un logon ke liye ek nasihat aur ek yaad-dihaani hai jo is se sabaq lena chahte hain. Is mein bahut sa faida aur bahut si bhalai hai. Phir bhi kya tum ise jhutlate ho? Kya tum is ke mazmoon ko nahin maanoge aur us par amal nahin karoge?
51: Aur Maine Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko un ke bachpan hi mein un ki qaum ke khilaaf daleel ata ki, aur Main unhein khoob jaanta tha. Maine unhein apne ilm ke mutabiq woh daleel di jis ke woh haqdaar the.
52: Jab unhon ne apne baap Aazar aur apni qaum se kaha: 'Yeh but kya hain jo tum ne apne haathon se banaye aur jin ki tum hamesha ibadat karte ho?'
53: Un ki qaum ne un se kaha: 'Hum ne apne bap-dada ko in ki ibadat karte paaya, lihaza hum ne bhi un ke namoone par in ki ibadat ki.'
54: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: 'Tum aur tumhare bap-dada haqq ke raaste se khuli gumraahi mein ho!'
55: Un ki qaum ne un se kaha: 'Kya tum apni is baat mein sanjeeda ho, ya mazaaq kar rahe ho?'
56: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Nahin, main sanjeeda hoon! Tumhara Rubb aasmaano aur zameen ka Rubb hai; Us ne unhein paida kiya jab ke un jaisi koi cheez pehle nahin thi. Aur main un logon mein se hoon jo gawahi dete hain ke Wohi tumhara Rubb hai aur aasmaano aur zameen ka Rubb hai, aur tumhare buton ka is mein koi hissa nahin!'
57: Aur Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne aisi aawaz mein, jo un ki qaum ne nahin suni, kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Jab tum apne but chhod kar apne tehwar par chale jaoge, to main un ke baare mein aisi tadbeer karoonga jo tumhein buri lagegi.'
58: Chunanche Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne buton ko choor choor kar diya aur un mein se sab se bade ko chhod diya, is umeed par ke log us ki taraf lautein aur us se poochein ke baaqi ko kis ne toda.
59: Phir jab woh laute aur apne buton ko tukde tukde paaya, to unhon ne ek doosre se poocha: 'Hamare buton ko kis ne toda? Be-shak jis ne inhein toda woh zaalimon mein se hai, kyunke us ne un cheezon ki be-izzati ki jo izzat aur taqdees ke laayak hain.'
60: Jin logon ne Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko Allah ki qasam kha kar yeh kehte suna tha ke woh buton ke khilaaf tadbeer karenge, unhon ne kaha: 'Hum ne ek naujawan ko in ke baare mein buri baat karte aur in mein aib nikaalte suna tha. Use Ibrahim ke naam se jaana jata hai; shayad usi ne inhein toda ho.'
61: Un ke sardaron ne kaha: 'Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko logon ke saamne laao taake woh us ke apne kiye ke iqrar par gawahi dein, aur un ki gawahi us ke khilaaf tumhari daleel ban jaye.'
62: Chunanche woh Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko le aaye aur un se sawal kiya, unhein ilzaam dete hue: 'Aey Ibrahim, kya tum ne hamare buton ke saath yeh bhayanak kaam kiya?'
63: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne, logon par buton ki be-bassi khol kar, tanz ke taur par kaha: 'Maine yeh nahin kiya; balke sab se bade but ne kiya. Apne buton se poochh lo, agar woh waqai bol sakte hain!'
64: Chunanche woh ek doosre ki taraf mude, soch-bichaar karte aur gaur karte hue. Un par wazeh ho gaya tha ke un ke but na koi faida de sakte hain aur na koi nuqsan, aur is liye woh Allah ke siwa un ki ibadat karne mein galat the.
65: Phir woh apni hath-dharmi aur apne inkaar ki taraf laut aaye aur kehne lage: 'Aey Ibrahim (alaihis salaam), tum khoob jaante ho ke yeh but bol nahin sakte, phir tum humein kaise kehte ho ke un se poochein?' Woh ise apne haqq mein daleel banana chahte the, magar woh un ke khilaaf daleel ban gayi.
66: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne unhein daantte hue kaha: 'Phir kya tum Allah ko chhod kar aise buton ki ibadat karte ho jo na tumhein koi faida dete hain aur na nuqsan; jo khud apne se koi nuqsan hatane ya apne liye koi faida laane mein be-bas hain?'
67: Tum par aur un par bhi afsos jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte ho, jo na faida dete hain aur na nuqsan! Kya tum yeh nahin samajhte? Kya tum un ki ibadat nahin chhodoge?
68: Jab woh Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ka daleel se muqabla karne mein aajiz ho gaye to woh taaqat par utar aaye aur kehne lage: 'Agar tum Ibrahim ko aisi saza dena chahte ho jo doosron ke liye ibrat ho, aur apne un buton ka badla lena chahte ho jinhein us ne toda aur barbaad kiya, to use aag mein jala do.'
69: Unhon ne aag jalayi aur Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko us mein daal diya, to Maine kaha: 'Aey aag, Ibrahim par thandi aur salaamati wali ho ja!' Aur woh waisi hi ho gayi, aur unhein koi nuqsan na pahuncha.
70: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ne unhein jalane ki tadbeer ki, aur Maine un ki tadbeer na-kaam kar di. Balke Maine unhein hi ghalib aane walon ke bajaye maghloob aur halak hone wale bana diya.
71: Aur Maine Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko bacha liya aur Maine Lut (alaihis salaam) ko bhi bacha liya. Maine unhein Shaam ki us sarzameen ki taraf nikaal diya jise Maine barkat di thi, is tarah ke Maine us ki taraf bahut se nabi bheje aur us mein makhlooq ke liye bahut si bhalaiyan phailayin.
72: Aur Maine Ibrahim ko Ishaq ki naimat di jab unhon ne apne Rubb se dua ki ke unhein koi aulaad de. Is ke saath Maine unhein Yaqub ki naimat bhi di. Aur Maine in teenon ko, yani Ibrahim, Ishaq aur Yaqub (alaihimus salaam) ko, neik aur apna farmanbardaar banaya.
73: Aur Maine unhein aise imam banaya jin ki log bhalai mein pairvi karte the. Woh Allah ke hukm se sirf Allah ki ibadat ki taraf bulate the. Aur Maine un par wahi ki ke woh neik kaam karein, namaz poore tareeqe se qayam karein aur zakaat dein. Aur woh Mere farmanbardaar the.
74: Aur Lut (alaihis salaam) ko Maine jhagadne walon ke darmiyan insaaf se faisla karne ki salaahiyat di, aur is ke saath apne deen ka durust ilm bhi. Aur Maine unhein us azaab se bhi bacha liya jo Maine un ki basti walon par bheja jo be-haayi mein mubtala the. Be-shak woh bigde hue log the jo apne Rubb ki ibadat se hat gaye the.
75: Aur Maine unhein apni rehmat mein daakhil kiya jab Maine unhein us azaab se bachaya jo un ki qaum par aaya. Be-shak woh un logon mein se the jo Mere ahkaam par chalte the aur Meri mana ki hui cheezon se bachte the.
76: Aey Rasool, Nooh ka qissa bayan kijiye jab unhon ne Ibrahim aur Lut (alaihimus salaam) se pehle Allah ko pukara, aur Us ne un ki pukar qabool ki aur unhein woh diya jo unhon ne maanga: Allah ne unhein aur un ke momin ghar walon ko bade gam se bacha liya.
77: Aur Maine unhein apni qaum ke un logon ki buri saazish se bacha liya jinhon ne un nishaniyon ko jhutlaya jin se Maine un ki madad ki thi; woh nishaniyan jo un ki sachhaai batati theen. Be-shak woh bure aur bigde hue log the, lihaza Maine un sab ko dubo kar halak kar diya.
78: Aey Rasool, Dawood aur un ke bete Sulaiman (alaihimus salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye jab woh us maamle mein faisla kar rahe the jo un ke paas do jhagadne walon ke baare mein laaya gaya: un mein se ek ka rewad raat ko doosre ke kheton mein ghus gaya tha. Aur Main Dawood aur Sulaiman ke faisle par gawah tha; un ke faisle ka koi hissa Mere ilm se bahar nahin tha.
79: Aur Maine is maamle ki poori samajh Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ko di, un ke baap Dawood (alaihis salaam) ke bajaye; phir bhi Maine in dono ko nabuwwat aur shariat ka ilm diya, sirf Sulaiman ko nahin. Aur Maine Dawood ke liye pahaad taabe kar diye jo un ke saath mil kar Meri paaki bayan karte the. Aur Maine un ke liye parinde bhi taabe kar diye. Aur Main hi tha jis ne yeh samajh di, insaaf wala faisla diya, ilm diya, aur pahaad aur parinde taabe kiye.
80: Aur Maine khaas taur par Dawood (alaihis salaam) ko, Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ko nahin, zirh banane ka hunar sikhaya, taake tum apne aap ko har us shaks se bacha sako jo tum par hathiyaar se hamla kare. Aey logo, phir kya tum is naimat par shukr ada karoge jo Maine tum par ki?
81: Aur Maine Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ke liye tez chalne wali hawa taabe kar di. Woh un ke hukm par, jab bhi woh use hukm dete, Shaam ki us sarzameen ki taraf chalti jise Maine nabi bhej kar aur us mein bhalaiyan phaila kar barkat di thi. Aur Main hi hoon jis ne yeh sab kiya; koi cheez Mere ilm se bahar nahin.
82: Aur Maine un shaytanon ko bhi taabe kar diya jo un ke liye samundaron mein ghota lagate the aur moti waghairah nikaalte the, aur is ke alawa taameer jaise doosre kaam bhi karte the. Aur Main un ki tadaad aur un ke kaam ki khoob nigraani karta tha; kuch bhi Meri nazar se bahar nahin tha.
83: Aey Rasool, Ayub (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye jab unhon ne apni takleef ke waqt apne Rubb se dua ki aur kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb, mujhe beemari aur ghar walon ke khasaare ne aa pakda hai, aur tu tamam reham karne walon se badh kar reham karne wala hai, lihaza jo museebatein mujh par aayi hain unhein hata de.'
84: Chunanche Maine un ki dua qabool ki aur jo takleef unhein pahunchi thi use hata diya; aur Maine unhein na sirf woh ghar wale diye jo woh kho chuke the, balke un ke saath aur bhi. Maine yeh sab apni rehmat se kiya, aur taake yeh Allah ke har us farmanbardaar bande ke liye nasihat ho jo Us ki ibadat karta hai, taake woh bhi usi tarah sabr kare jis tarah Ayub (alaihis salaam) ne sabr kiya.
85: Aey Rasool, Ismail, Idris aur Zul-Kifl (alaihimus salaam) ka bhi zikr kijiye. In mein se har ek un logon mein se tha jo takleef ke waqton par aur us har zimmedaari par sabr karte the jo Allah ne un par daali.
86: Aur Maine unhein apni rehmat mein le liya: Maine unhein nabi banaya aur unhein Jannat mein daakhle ki naimat di. Be-shak woh Mere un neik bandon mein se the jo Meri itaat mein amal karte the aur jin ki chhipi aur khuli zindagi parhezgaari ki thi.
87: Aey Rasool, Machhli wale, yani Yunus (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bhi bayan kijiye, jab woh apne Rubb ki ijazat ke bagair chale gaye, apni qaum ke gunah par ade rehne se naraaz ho kar. Unhon ne samjha ke Main unhein un ke jaldi chale jaane par saza de kar tang nahin karoonga; phir unhein ek sakht tangi aur qaid ne aa pakda jab machhli unhein nigal gayi. Phir unhon ne machhli ke pet, samundar aur raat ke andheron mein pukara, apni galti maante hue aur Allah ki taraf us se tauba karte hue, aur kaha: 'Tere siwa koi sachcha maabood nahin, tu har aib se paak aur mubarra hai. Be-shak main zaalimon mein se tha.'
88: Chunanche Maine un ki pukar qabool ki aur unhein us sakht takleef se bacha liya: unhein tamam andheron se aur machhli ke pet se nikaal kar. Aur jis tarah Maine Yunus (alaihis salaam) ko is takleef se bachaya, usi tarah Main mominon ko bhi bachata hoon jab woh takleef mein pad jate hain aur madad ke liye Mujhe pukarte hain.
89: Aey Rasool, Zakariya (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bhi bayan kijiye jab unhon ne apne Rubb se dua ki aur kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb, mujhe bina aulaad ke yakta na chhod. Tu sab se behtar baaqi rehne wala hai, lihaza mujhe aisi aulaad de jo mere baad zinda rahe.'
90: Chunanche Maine un ke liye un ki dua qabool ki aur unhein Yahya (alaihis salaam) ki soorat mein aulaad ata ki. Aur is ke saath Maine un ki biwi ko bhi theek kar diya jo us waqt tak baanjh thi. Be-shak Zakariya (alaihis salaam), un ki biwi aur un ka beta neik kaamon mein jald aage barhne wale the, aur Mujhe pukarte the, Mere ajr ke shauqeen aur Mere azaab se darte hue. Aur woh Mujh se bahut dua karte the.
91: Aey Rasool, Maryam (alaihas salaam) ka qissa bhi bayan kijiye, jinhon ne apne aap ko zina se mehfooz rakha. Phir Allah ne un ki taraf Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ko bheja aur unhon ne un mein phoonk maari. Is ke natije mein woh Isa (alaihis salaam) se haamla ho gayin; woh dono logon ke liye Allah ki qudrat ki nishaniyan the, aur is baat ki dalilein ke koi cheez Allah ke bas se bahar nahin ke Us ne Isa ko baap ke bagair paida kiya.
92: Aey logo, yeh tumhara deen hai; ek hi deen. Yeh tauheed hai jo Islam ka deen hai. Aur Main tumhara Rubb hoon, lihaza ibadat sirf Mere liye khaalis karo.
93: Magar logon ne ikhtilaaf kiya: kuch mowahhid hue, kuch mushrik, kuch kafir aur kuch momin. Yeh tamam qism ke log Qayamat ke din sirf Meri taraf lautenge, jab Main unhein un ke aamaal ke mutabiq badla doonga.
94: Phir un mein se jis ne neik kaam kiye jab ke woh Allah, Us ke rasoolon aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhta tha, use us ke neik aamaal ka haqq nahin maara jayega. Balke Allah us ke liye us ka ajr kai guna barha dega aur woh use apne aamaal-naame mein likha hua paayega jis din use uthaya jayega, aur woh is par khush hoga.
95: Aur jis basti ke logon ko Maine un ke kufr ki wajah se halak kar diya, un ke liye na-mumkin hai ke woh duniya mein tauba karne ke liye lautein aur Main un ki tauba qabool karoon.
96: Woh kabhi nahin lautenge, yahan tak ke Yajuj aur Majuj ki aad khol di jaye aur woh nikalne lagein, har oonchi jagah se jald utarte hue.
97: Aur un ka nikalna, un ki dehshat aur un ka zulm Qayamat ke qareeb aane ki nishani hoga. Aur kafir hairat se aankhein phaade reh jayenge aur kahenge: haaye, hum par kaisi barbaadi aa padi! Hum duniya mein be-kaar baaton mein pade rahe aur is sakht din ki tayyari se gaafil rahe. Balke hum zaalim the, kufr aur gunah karke.
98: Aey mushriko, tum aur woh sab jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte ho, un ke saath jo tumhare un ki ibadat par raazi hain, Jahannam ka eendhan banoge. Tum aur jin ki tum ibadat karte ho sab us mein zaroor daakhil hoge.
99: Agar yeh pooje jaane wale waqai aise maabood hote jo ibadat ke laayak hote, to woh apne poojne walon ke saath Jahannam mein daakhil na hote. Magar woh sab us mein daakhil honge aur us mein hamesha rahenge, kabhi us se nahin niklenge.
100: Us azaab ki shiddat ki wajah se jis ka unhein saamna hoga, woh chikhenge aur tez saansein lenge. Aur woh us shadeed haulnaak azaab ki wajah se jo un par aayega koi aawaz nahin sun sakenge.
101: Jab mushrikon ne kaha: 'To phir Isa aur woh farishte, jin ki ibadat ki jati thi, bhi Jahannam mein daakhil honge!' to Allah ne farmaya: 'Be-shak jin ke baare mein Allah ke ilm mein yeh tai ho chuka ke woh khush-naseeb logon mein se honge, jaise Isa (alaihis salaam), woh Jahannam se door rakhe jayenge.'
102: Us ki aawaz un ke kaanon tak nahin pahunchegi, aur woh un tamam naimaton mein rahenge jin ki un ke dil chaahat karenge. Aur yeh naimatein kabhi khatam nahin hongi.
103: Jahannam ki woh bari dehshat, jab woh apne rehne walon ko gher legi, unhein nahin daraayegi, aur farishte unhein khush-khabri ke saath khush-aamdeed kahenge aur kahenge: 'Yeh tumhara woh din hai jis ka duniya mein tum se wada kiya gaya tha; woh din jis mein tumhein naimaton ki khush-khabri di gayi thi!'
104: Jis din Main aasman ko is tarah lapet doonga jaise likhne ka warq lapeta jata hai, aur makhlooq ko usi haal mein jama karoonga jis mein woh pehli baar paida ki gayi thi. Maine wada kiya hai ke aisa hoga; aisa wada jis se koi palat nahin. Main zaroor apna wada poora karoonga.
105: Aur Maine un kitabon mein jo Maine rasoolon par utari, is ke baad ke Maine use Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein likh diya tha, likh diya ke zameen par Allah ke neik aur farmanbardaar bande hukumat karenge: aur woh Muhammad ﷺ ki ummat hai.
106: Be-shak us nasihat mein jo Maine utari, un logon ke liye ek paigham hai jo apne Rubb ki ibadat usi tareeqe se karte hain jo Us ne un ke liye muqarrar kiya. Yahi log hain jo sach-much is se faida uthate hain.
107: Aey Muhammad ﷺ, Maine aap ko rasool bana kar sirf is liye bheja ke aap tamam makhlooq ke liye rehmat hon. Yeh is liye hai ke aap tamam logon ki hidayat aur unhein Allah ke azaab se bachane ki chaahat rakhne mein sab se barh kar hain.
108: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: mujh par mere Rubb ki taraf se sirf yeh wahi ki jati hai ke tumhara sachcha maabood sirf ek hai; Us ka koi sharik nahin, aur Woh Allah hai. Lihaza Us par iman la kar aur Us ki itaat mein amal karke jhuk jao.
109: Aey Rasool, agar yeh log us baat se munh mod lein jo aap un ke paas laaye, to un se keh dijiye: 'Main tumhein bata raha hoon ke hum dono is baat par mutaffiq hain ke hum alag hain, aur mujhe nahin maaloom ke jis azaab ka Allah ne tum se wada kiya woh tum par kab utrega.'
110: Be-shak Allah woh baat jaanta hai jo tum zaahir karte ho, aur Woh woh bhi jaanta hai jo tum chhipate ho. In mein se kuch Us se bachta nahin, aur Woh tumhein us ka badla dega.
111: Aur mujhe nahin maaloom ke azaab se tumhari yeh mohlat tumhare liye ek aazmaish hai, ya yeh is liye hai ke tumhein aur halakat ki taraf kheencha jaye aur tumhein ek muqarrar waqt tak, jo Allah ke ilm mein hai, dheel di jaye, taake tum apne kufr aur apni gumraahi par ade raho.
112: Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne apne Rubb se dua karte hue kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb, hamare aur apni qaum ke un logon ke darmiyan haqq ke saath faisla kar de jo kufr par ade rahe. Aur hum sirf apne Rubb se madad maangte hain tumhari un kufr aur jhutlane wali baaton ke muqable mein.'
